provenance_note: No in-repo JustSearch MCP tool today both omits structuredContent AND returns a multi-block content list, so there is no real endpoint to capture this shape from -- it is synthesized directly from the Claude Agent SDK's own type contract: `ToolResultBlock.content: str | list[dict[str, Any]] | None` (claude_agent_sdk, confirmed against the installed package -- see tests/test_agent_utility_inspect.py::test_record_cell_tool_result_digests_furniture_markers_block_list_content_shape for the same shape used elsewhere in this suite). Each block follows the MCP TextContent shape (`{"type": "text", "text": ...}`) that McpToolSurface.java itself emits for every text block it constructs (e.g. callStatus at McpToolSurface.java:940, callOperation at McpToolSurface.java:985/988). This fixture exists to exercise the `_delivered_tier` == "blocks" branch (list input) independent of any specific tool's real behavior.
